parameters.name: GmtEndTime
parameters.description: The end time in UTC. Use the ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: GmtStartTime
parameters.description: The start time in UTC. Use the ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DSW instance.

parameters.name: LogLevel
parameters.description:
The log level. The supported level is:

- Error

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order.

- ASC: Ascending

- DESC: Descending

parameters.name: ProblemCategory
parameters.description:
The category of the problem.

- InstanceStartFailed

- InstanceTerminating

- InstanceCreateFailed

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the results by. Supported fields:

- GmtCreateTime

- GmtModifiedTime

parameters.name: SourceRequestId
parameters.description: The ID of the request that has an error.
